prompts.full: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image: the supplied silver luxury watch defines the design and finish. Create ONE full uncropped photorealistic studio product photograph of this same watch, suitable for image-to-3D reconstruction. Entire watch and entire CLOSED bracelet loop including rear clasp visible within frame with generous 12% margin. Three-quarter front view slightly above, dial clearly visible, whole continuous oval bracelet visible behind/below the case, no cut ends. Silver three-link articulated bracelet, brushed outer links polished center links, matching closed clasp. Round silver case, black sunray dial, simple silver baton indices and hands, no branding. CRITICAL: continuous evenly spaced complete 360-degree ring of round brilliant diamonds around bezel, including upper arc at 11,12,1 o'clock: NO empty metal arc, no missing stones. Each diamond has crisp planar crown facets, flat octagonal table and sharp girdle, NOT rounded bubbles or crumpled foil. Clear crowns with lower concealed seats, no prongs over tables. Neutral pale gray seamless background, restrained broad studio lights, sharp focus throughout whole object, no depth-of-field blur, realistic fine brushed metal texture and controlled diamond reflections. Not a collage, no labels, no extra objects, no crop, no watermarks. Preserve original design language while extending band to a complete coherent wearable closed bracelet.
prompts.macro: Use case: product-mockup. Input image is design reference. Produce one extremely high-detail photorealistic macro reference photograph of the DIAMOND BEZEL of this watch, five adjacent identical round brilliant-cut diamonds seen from a three-quarter elevated face angle, tightly framed but all five stones complete. Each gem clearly has an optically flat octagonal table, eight sharp star facets, orderly triangular bezel crown facets and a circular crisp girdle; clear transparent colorless diamond, realistic internal reflections with restrained small spectral fire. Facets are flat polished optical planes, NOT bumpy pebbles, NOT crumpled metal, NOT molten chrome, NOT dome-shaped lenses. Each stone's entire upper crown and table unobstructed, subtle same-silver lower seat only below girdle. All five aligned evenly around polished silver bezel with brushed case edge and a small portion of the black sunray dial. Neutral balanced studio illumination with broad white softboxes and black reflection cards; controlled exposure so facet boundaries and table remain easy to read, no giant starbursts, no excessive chromatic glare. Focus-stacked tack-sharp all five diamonds, exceptionally detailed clean geometry, no text, no branding, no arrows. This is a precise visual modeling reference and realistic luxury macro photograph.
